title: The canonical identification is uniquely fixed by the coprojection at `(u,id)`.
statement:
Let $X,Y$ be schemes in universe $u$ and $f:X\to Y$ an isomorphism [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Use their small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Let $D:\mathrm{Type}(v)$ be a category with morphisms in universe $u+1$, admitting all colimits with objects and morphisms in universe $u+1$, and assume weak sheafification for $D$-valued presheaves on $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$ [def-weil-pbc-sheafification]. A $D$-valued sheaf means a presheaf $F$ for which $\operatorname{Hom}_D(A,F(-))$ is a sheaf of sets for each $A\in D$; sheaf morphisms are natural transformations.

Write $b:Y_{\mathrm{proet}}\to X_{\mathrm{proet}}$ for the chosen base-change functor of [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image], and put $\Phi_f(U\xrightarrow{u_U}X)=(U\xrightarrow{f u_U}Y)$, with the same underlying scheme arrow on morphisms. Set
$$L_fF=(\operatorname{Lan}_{b^{\mathrm{op}}}F)^\#,$$
and let $R_fG=G\circ b^{\mathrm{op}}$. Use the constructed adjunction $L_f\dashv R_f$: its unit $\eta_F:F\to R_fL_fF$ is the Kan-extension unit followed by the sheafification unit, restricted to sheaves. This is precisely the construction denoted by inverse image and adjunction in [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image], here with the displayed general value category $D$. For $U\in X_{\mathrm{proet}}$, let
$$\theta_U:U\longrightarrow b(\Phi_fU)$$
be the fibre-product arrow with projections $(u_U,\mathrm{id}_U)$ [def-pc-fibre-product]; equivalently, it is the component of the postcomposition/base-change adjunction unit.

Let $I_X,I_Y$ denote inclusion of sheaves into presheaves and let $T_f(F)=F\circ\Phi_f^{\mathrm{op}}$, on morphisms by precomposition. There is a unique natural isomorphism of functors $\operatorname{Sh}(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},D)\to\operatorname{PSh}(X_{\mathrm{proet}},D)$,
$$e:L_f\,;\,I_X\xrightarrow{\sim}I_Y\,;\,T_f,$$
where the semicolon denotes composition in diagram order, such that for every $D$-valued sheaf $F$ on $Y_{\mathrm{proet}}$ and every $U\in X_{\mathrm{proet}}$,
$$ (e_F^{-1})_U=(L_fF)(\theta_U)\circ(\eta_F)_{\Phi_fU}:F(\Phi_fU)\longrightarrow (L_fF)(U).$$
The natural isomorphism is natural both in $F$ and in $U$.

proof.text: The existing MorphismProperty.Over.mapPullbackAdj for f is an adjunction between postcomposition and base change. Both functors are continuous by the existing pro-etale site instances. Adjunction.sheafPushforwardContinuous lifts this to an adjunction whose left functor is sectionwise postcomposition and whose right functor is precisely the recorded direct image [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. Compare it with the recorded inverse-image/direct-image adjunction by Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq and whisker its isomorphism with sheafToPresheaf. The inverse component is the recorded unit evaluated at the postcomposed object followed by the lifted counit. The lifted counit is restriction along the site-adjunction unit, definitionally proEtaleIsoCommaArrow f U. Thus this isomorphism satisfies the stated normalization. Any other normalized isomorphism has exactly the same inverse components on every sheaf and site object; Iso.ext_inv and natural-transformation extensionality give equality.

lean.statement:
theorem existsUnique_proEtaleIsoInverseImageIdentification {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso f] (D : Type v) [Category.{u + 1} D]
    [HasColimitsOfSize.{u + 1, u + 1} D] [HasWeakSheafify (ProEt.topology X) D] :
    ∃! e : proEtaleSheafInverseImage f D ⋙ sheafToPresheaf (ProEt.topology X) D ≅
        sheafToPresheaf (ProEt.topology Y) D ⋙
          (Functor.whiskeringLeft _ _ D).obj (proEtaleIsoPostcompose f).op,
      ∀ (F : Sheaf (ProEt.topology Y) D) (U : X.ProEt),
        (e.inv.app F).app (op U) =
          ((proEtaleSheafAdjunction f D).unit.app F).hom.app
              (op ((proEtaleIsoPostcompose f).obj U)) ≫
            ((proEtaleSheafInverseImage f D).obj F).obj.map
              (proEtaleIsoCommaArrow f U).op := by
  sorry
